quarterly_data.signal: Positive profit alert (7 July 2026, based on a preliminary assessment of unaudited management accounts): the board expects the Group's net profit for the six months ended 30 June 2026 to increase by approximately 150% to 170% versus the six months ended 30 June 2025, primarily from higher revenue from data centre in the cable assembly sector and from the server sector, and a higher share of associated companies' results; the figures are subject to finalisation and potential adjustment.
